What should I do if the tracking never updates?
14:09
Rosie
•
AI Agent

If your tracking information does not update after your order has been dispatched, here are a few steps you can take:

Allow Some Time: Occasionally, it can take up to 24 hours for tracking details to appear or update after dispatch, especially during busy periods.
Check Your Email: Ensure you have received the correct tracking number and carrier information. Sometimes, tracking links are included in a separate email.
Review Spam/Junk Folders: Tracking emails can sometimes be filtered into these folders.
Contact Us: If your tracking has not updated for more than 48 hours after dispatch, or if you are concerned about the status of your delivery, please contact us with your order number or the email address used for your purchase. We will investigate the matter with the courier and provide you with an update as soon as possible.

If you would like us to look into your specific order and tracking, please provide your order number or email address, and we will be happy to assist further.
